scene: You step off your humming scooter into the bustling, sunlit Piazza Nova.
picture: Flat side-view across the paved piazza. On the far left sits a striped gelato cart. To its right, the player in a pink tracksuit holds her white dog's lead beside her hovering blue scooter. In the centre spouts a marble fountain, while on the right stands a brass pasta spinner.
shown: a striped gelato cart with bright green scoops on the far left
an ornate marble fountain spouting sparkling water in the centre
a brass pasta-spinning machine twirling yellow ribbons on the right
